title: REPL Variable Utilities
summary: This module defines the `REPLVariable` class, which encapsulates metadata about variables available in a Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) environment. It provides methods to create, format, and serialize variable information for display or prompt inclusion.

nodes.label: Represent REPL Variable Metadata
nodes.title: REPLVariable Class
nodes.description: A Pydantic model that stores and formats metadata for a variable within a REPL session, including its name, type, description, constraints, total length, and a preview of its value. It can be instantiated from an actual Python value.

nodes.label: Define Data Models
nodes.title: pydantic.BaseModel
nodes.description: The base class from Pydantic used for creating data models with type hints and validation. REPLVariable inherits from this to define its structure and behavior.

nodes.label: Access Pydantic Field Info
nodes.title: pydantic.FieldInfo
nodes.description: Pydantic's class for storing metadata about a field in a model, including default values, descriptions, and constraints. Used by REPLVariable to extract additional context.

nodes.label: Handle JSON Data
nodes.title: json Module
nodes.description: Python's standard library module for encoding and decoding JSON data. Used by REPLVariable to serialize complex Python objects into JSON strings for preview.

nodes.label: Convert Value to JSON-serializable
nodes.title: serialize_for_json Function
nodes.description: A utility function (assumed external to this module) responsible for converting arbitrary Python values into a format that can be easily serialized to JSON. Used by REPLVariable's `from_value` method.
